items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That name does not ring a bell. No, it doesn't.

ctx.x: No, I came back to Indianapolis and just kind of wandered around as an unemployed musician. I recall that I was able to sit in with – I don’t know who was prominent or active, I should say, at that time as far as Indianapolis bands were concerned – but I remember playing with either [Jimmy] Coe or maybe LaVon Kemp was still around. I don’t just remember. I’m a little fuzzy there.
Was Syd Valentine here? And the alto player who later on owned a hair place? I just wondered if those were . . .
That name does not ring a bell. No, it doesn’t.
